fields.name: density
fields.rationale: The density of the product is explicitly provided as 1710 kg/m³, which is a key material property for categorizing and comparing different mortar products.

fields.name: seismic_approval
fields.rationale: The product is explicitly stated to be ETA approved for seismic C2 category for anchoring, which is a critical functional property for construction materials used in seismic zones.
evidence: HIT-HY170 is ETA approved for seismic C2 category for anchoring.

fields.name: component_system
fields.rationale: The product is described as a two-component system, which is a common classification for chemical mortars and affects its application and handling.
evidence: The declared product of HIT-HY 170 is a two component system.

fields.name: styrene_free
fields.rationale: The product is noted to contain no styrene, which is a significant feature for user safety and environmental impact, distinguishing it from other products that may contain volatile organic compounds.
evidence: The reaction resins used in all Hilti hybrid adhesives contain no styrene.

fields.name: installation_method
fields.rationale: The product is part of the Hilti SAFEset system, which includes specific installation methods using Hilti Hollow Drill bits and vacuum cleaners, indicating specialized application techniques.
evidence: Hilti SAFEset is an approved system which makes anchor installation an easier, safer and faster process.
inference_basis: SAFEset system implies specialized installation method.

fields.name: curing_time
fields.rationale: The product is described to have high bond strengths within a short curing time, which is a critical performance characteristic for construction materials.
evidence: high bond strengths within a short curing time
inference_basis: Short curing time is a key performance indicator for fast-setting mortars.
